blocks.x: Funding for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program NEA Jazz Master interview was provided by the National Endowment for the Arts.
Interviewees: Jimmy Cobb (January 20, 1929 – May 24, 2020) and Eleana Steinberg Cobb Interviewer: William Brower with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 120 pp.

It is Monday, July 26th, the year 2010. I am William Alston Brower. I am here to interview Jimmy Cobb on behalf of the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program. We’re in New York City at the Wells Hotel. Mr. Cobb, if you could – we want to go from the beginning. So would you introduce us to your parents?
